description: A percentage min-width/min-height resolves against a definite containing block, and a percentage min-height against an auto-height one is ignored.

florui.css: .fixed { width: 200px; height: 100px; } .m { width: 10px; height: 10px; min-width: 50%; min-height: 50%; background-color: #2f7d6c; } .auto { width: 200px; } .i { height: 10px; min-height: 50%; background-color: #c0392b; }
